# ClearFlow Plumbing & Maintenance

> Licensed plumbing contractor serving Sydney metropolitan area, Central Coast and beyond. AS 3500 compliant. Licence 379466C.

ClearFlow Plumbing & Maintenance delivers residential, commercial, and industrial plumbing with transparent mid-range pricing, clean respectful service, and 24/7 emergency response.

## Services

- Jet blasting — high-pressure clearing for drains, sewers, and commercial kitchen lines
- CCTV drainage camera — video inspection and pinpoint reporting
- Locating services — non-invasive pipe and cable detection
- Construction plumbing — rough-in and fit-off for renovations and new builds
- Commercial plumbing — fit-outs, strata, hospitality, healthcare
- Backflow & TMV testing — compliance testing and documentation
- Industrial plumbing — warehouses, manufacturing, large facilities
